name: @pipeworx/mcp-coinbase-exchange

tools.name: products
tools.description: Coinbase Exchange — list all available trading pairs (products) with base/quote currency, min order size, status, and trading rules.

tools.name: product_book
tools.description: Coinbase Exchange (US-regulated crypto venue) live order book — bids + asks for a crypto pair like "BTC-USD". Levels 1-3 control depth. Use for spread analysis, liquidity assessment, market making.

tools.name: product_ticker
tools.description: Coinbase Exchange (US-regulated crypto venue) — best bid/ask, last trade price, and volume for a crypto pair. Use for current pricing on a Coinbase-listed pair.

tools.name: product_trades
tools.description: Coinbase Exchange — recent trade tape for a crypto pair (e.g. 'BTC-USD'): trade ID, price, size, side, and timestamp. Supports limit and before/after cursor pagination.

tools.name: product_candles
tools.description: Coinbase Exchange OHLC candles for a crypto pair. Granularity 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h, 1d. Use for charting and backtesting on Coinbase-listed pairs.

tools.name: product_stats
tools.description: Coinbase Exchange 24-hour rolling stats for a crypto pair: open, high, low, last, volume, 30-day volume. Use for daily summary.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-coinbase-exchange forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the coinbase-exchange pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
